---
title: |
  A *literal* title
author: Jane Doe
date: 2025-04-30
citation: true
google-scholar: true
appendix-cite-as: [display, bibtex]
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['meta[name="citation_title"][content="A literal title"]']
      ensureHtmlElementContents:
        selectors: ['.quarto-appendix-citeas', '.quarto-appendix-bibtex']
        matches: ['Literal']
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<em>Literal</em>']
---

A literal block scalar title keeps its formatting and has no newline in the metadata.
